Prep for this route: ladder\prep\SaveGameList-2001.sav instead of SaveGameList.sav (HL-0c-09 registered with SaveTime 2001-01-01, the oldest save of its character), and ladder files rebuilt with hl_save.py ladder-file --savetime 2001-01-01T00:00:00 (or the raw copies, if the game does not read the file's DirectoryEntry). Route: card (loads the character's newest autosave: one extra world load) > Esc > 설정 (opens on the 게임 저장 page) > 게임 불러오기 (392, 218 on that page, runs\discover\hogwarts\09.png) > the character's save list (TBD: order, scroll, row layout; assumed newest first, so the 2001 slot is the last row, like Wukong's slot 9) > hover the last row > the load question > confirm > loading > play > quit. This route also answers 'load a specific slot' for the user's own manual saves without any prep (HL-01-00..05 keep their 2024/2025 dates, so their rows are fixed below the 5 autosaves).
